segments.headline: REVOKED ACCESS. NEXT ACTION?
segments.body: Revocation must stop the next protected tool call.
segments.spoken: You revoked your AI agent's access. Does its next tool call still work? Test this before deployment.

segments.headline: NIST proposed ten design tenets
segments.body: October 27, 2026. These three operator tests are PrismBay's interpretation.
segments.spoken: On October twenty seventh, NIST proposed ten agent identity design tenets. Here are three practical operator tests.

segments.headline: 01 / Distinct agent identity
segments.spoken: First, give each agent a distinct identity. Never share an administrator login. Link actions to an accountable owner.

segments.headline: 02 / Mid-task revocation
segments.body: The next protected action must fail at the service.
segments.spoken: Second, revoke a short-lived permission mid-task. The next protected tool call must fail at the service, not merely in the prompt.

segments.headline: 03 / Independent evidence
segments.body: Log the owner, revocation time and denied action.
segments.spoken: Third, keep independent evidence of who authorized the task, when access ended, and what the agent tried next. Prevent the agent editing those records.

segments.headline: Test the stop before launch
